purpose: Why this repository uses LOCAL alignment for sequence identity. Global alignment forces end-to-end matching, which inflates identity between unrelated proteins to the point that a 30% threshold admits about a tenth of all pairs; the transitive closure of that similarity graph merges the entire dataset into one component, leaving no family to hold out.
interpretation: Under global alignment the median identity between arbitrary pairs is 0.228 and 10.7% of all pairs reach 30%. Under local alignment the median is 0.048 and only 1.4% reach 30%, while genuine homologs still sit above 90% (p99 = 0.928). The local distribution is bimodal, so the clustering is stable across thresholds from 0.25 to 0.60.
